widgets_values: A curious child and a small woodland friend discover who has been borrowing the moonlight. A gentle adventure about kindness and sharing.
Warm, hand-painted children's picture-book illustration, soft gouache and coloured-pencil texture, expressive friendly faces, clear silhouettes, gentle lighting, a cohesive warm pastel palette.
nodes.title: 01 · Story and book controls

widgets_values:
Write a premise and choose the age range, page count and art style in stage 01. Click Run once.

The story is written and checked first. The workflow then creates a common style reference, the entire cast, the cover and every page, and saves a readable book. Characters and pages are processed automatically in dependency order.
nodes.title: CHILDREN’S BOOK GENERATOR · V2

widgets_values:
Seed control defaults to randomize: each new run creates a separate book. To resume a failed run, load that job from History so its original seed is restored, set the control to fixed, then Run. Verified completed assets are reused.

Output: ComfyUI/output/codex/books/. Each book has story.json, numbered pages, character references, a cover, book.html and a separate production manifest.
nodes.title: A new book, or resume this one

widgets_values:
Every scene selects its own character references. Empty scenes use only the style reference. Pages reuse the canonical portraits, never the previous page.

Story JSON keeps the original id/pages/metadata schema, exact field casing and character-name arrays. Automation data is saved separately.
nodes.title: Consistency and app compatibility

widgets_values:
Uses your existing Qwen Image and Qwen Image Edit 2509 models at 1024 × 1024. The common style reference uses the matching 8-step Qwen Image Lightning LoRA. Character and scene rendering uses the base Edit model, 40 steps and CFG 4.

Changing render settings creates a separate rendition. PDF export is optional; story text is typeset separately from artwork.
nodes.title: Render settings

book_builder.notes: All originals preserved. Requires the local comfyui-book-builder node pack.
